item.text:
Implemented the Projects checkpoint in [server.js](/home/agent/work/server.js). It serves the project list and detail pages, validates and trims project names, and stores projects in SQLite using `DB_PATH`.

Start it with `npm start`. It binds to `0.0.0.0` on `PORT` (default `8080`); the default database is `./data/workboard.sqlite`.

Commit: `9e208b6fa176f7e8cdbd8f6b57eb0101ff1da0ef`. The working tree is clean. Verified JavaScript syntax and Git diff formatting; I did not run application tests.
